tests.name: Real launch: namespace, record=false, clean process shutdown
QoS live: reliable timeout, best_effort receives
One MCAP topic; 365 recorded = 365 replayed poses in exact order; reliable=0

defect.reproducer: ros2 launch course_bringup patrol.launch.py namespace:=robot_a subscriber_reliability:=reliable record:=false; timeout 4s ros2 topic echo /robot_a/sensor_pose --once --qos-reliability reliable => exit=124. Topic info and callback log in qos-before.txt.
defect.root_cause: Relay offers BEST_EFFORT / VOLATILE; reliable reader requests a stronger reliability policy, so DDS does not match them. Topic discovery succeeds independently of QoS delivery.
defect.proof_after: Launch with subscriber_reliability:=best_effort; echo exit=0. One MCAP containing /robot_a/sensor_pose was replayed with config/qos-overrides.yaml: reliable got 0, best_effort got all 365 recorded messages, equal in order and values. See qos-after.txt, bag-metadata.yaml and capture-summary.json.
